# Roofing Repair Insurance

> Roofing Repair Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for roofing repair contractors, Workers' Compensation for roofing repair contractors, Commercial Auto Insurance for roofing repair contractors, Tools & Equipment Coverage for roofing repair contractors, Storm Damage Restoration Coverage for roofing repair contractors, Commercial Umbrella Insurance for roofing repair contractors, Commercial Property Insurance for roofing repair contractors, Contractors Pollution Liability for roofing repair contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
